name.fr-FR: Défense de l’Estendart de la sainte Croix
name.en-US: Defence of the Standard of the Holy Cross
name.pt-BR: Defesa do Estandarte da santa Cruz

description.fr-FR: La réfutation, en quatre livres, du traité du ministre Antoine Fay contre le culte de la Croix, composée par saint François de Sales en 1597-1600 : l’honneur dû à la vraie Croix, à son image, ses miracles et son usage, et la qualité de l’honneur qu’on lui doit. Texte critique des Œuvres d’Annecy (tome II) en orthographe d’époque.
description.en-US: The refutation, in four books, of the minister Antoine Fay’s treatise against the veneration of the Cross, written by St. Francis de Sales in 1597-1600: the honour due to the true Cross, to its image, its miracles and use, and the kind of honour owed to it. The critical text of the Annecy edition (vol. II) in period spelling.
description.pt-BR: A refutação, em quatro livros, do tratado do ministro Antoine Fay contra o culto da Cruz, composta por São Francisco de Sales em 1597-1600.

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. II: Défense de l’Estendart de la sainte Croix, 1892 (file 02), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1892-1932. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu.
sources.description: Francis’s text in the original 17th-century spelling, extracted from the PDF page images’ text layer word by word, dropping the right-hand column of marginal synopses and references. The editors’ preface, variants and footnotes, tables and appendices are not included. The four books are one chapter each; the chapter, article and proof headings the text layer preserved are set as second-level headings.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition is of his own text in period spelling, published in or before 1932. Only Francis’s own text is used, not the editors’ apparatus.
